title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten distinct Calvin study settings, selected for documented features such as quiet rooms, presentation screens, natural light, flexible seating, and group-work tables. Check current building access before going.

cards.title: Settle In by the Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Hekman Library · third floor
cards.notes: Choose a booth, hanging swing, or comfortable chair in the third-floor lobby; check library hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A fireplace-centered library lobby with several seating styles for reading or laptop work.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies the lobby off Hekman Library's third floor as a study space with a fireplace, hanging swings, booths, and comfortable seating.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Located inside Hekman Library; consult the library's current hours and exception schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Read Among the History Shelves
cards.subtitle: Hiemenga Hall · fourth floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or writing work to the fourth-floor library, where floor-to-ceiling bookshelves define the study setting.
cards.short_summary: A department library suited to focused work within Hiemenga Hall's Historical Studies area.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin documents the Historical Studies Library on Hiemenga Hall's fourth floor as a work space with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Inside an academic building; normal building access and student-card rules apply, with Sunday closure unless an approved exception exists.

cards.title: Use the Window-Lined Main Level
cards.subtitle: Science Building · main level
cards.notes: Take daylight-dependent work to the main lobby, where multistory windows and interior greenery shape the workspace.
cards.short_summary: A bright Science Building study area anchored by tall windows and greenery.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin describes the Science Building's main-level lobby as a study setting with windows extending multiple floors and sprawling greenery.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Inside an academic building; use posted building access periods and authenticated student-card access where required.

cards.entity_name: Covenant Fine Arts Center Practice Rooms
cards.title: Work Behind a Closed Door
cards.subtitle: Covenant Fine Arts Center · practice-room area
cards.notes: Use a practice room for individual music preparation or other quiet, focused work only when your access permits it.
cards.short_summary: Closed-door rooms intended for solitary concentration and musical practice.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies the CFAC practice rooms as closed-door spaces for quiet focus and practicing music in solitude.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to Covenant Fine Arts Center access and any practice-room eligibility or scheduling rules; verify locally before occupying a room.

cards.title: Spread Out Beside the Glass
cards.subtitle: School of Business and DeVos Communication Center connector
cards.notes: Pick seating that fits solo or group work, and use the floor-to-ceiling windows when natural light supports your task.
cards.short_summary: A connector lobby offering varied seating and expansive windows on Calvin's east campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin says the renovated lobby connecting the School of Business and DeVos Communication Center has varied seating and floor-to-ceiling windows.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Academic-building access rules apply; Calvin documents Sunday student-card access to DeVos/School of Business from 1:00–6:00 p.m. during fall and spring.

cards.title: Study in the Two-Story Lobby
cards.subtitle: Spoelhof University Center · beyond the front desk
cards.notes: Move beyond the front desk and choose among the lobby's seating options; the fireplace and daylight mark the space.
cards.short_summary: An expansive, two-story lobby combining varied seating, natural light, and a fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin describes the lobby beyond the Spoelhof University Center front desk as a two-story study area with a fireplace, natural light, and varied seating.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Use only while the university center is open and follow any posted event or visitor restrictions.

cards.title: Work Overlooking the Climbing Wall
cards.subtitle: Spoelhof Fieldhouse Complex · lobby
cards.notes: Choose the larger area overlooking the climbing wall or a smaller seating pocket with a fireplace for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A fieldhouse lobby with both an overlook study zone and smaller fireplace seating areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin documents a large lobby study area overlooking the 40-foot climbing wall plus smaller seating pockets with fireplaces.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Fieldhouse access varies by day and term; student/staff card access extends beyond unlocked hours on specified fall and spring days.

cards.title: Take a Tall Table by the Glass
cards.subtitle: North Hall · second floor
cards.notes: Head to the second-floor Glass Lobby for natural light and tall tables suited to writing, reading, or laptop work.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor North Hall study area distinguished by glass, daylight, and tall tables.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies North Hall's second-floor Glass Lobby as a study space with natural light, tall tables, and chairs.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Inside an academic building; observe normal unlocked hours, student-card periods, and Sunday restrictions.

cards.title: Rehearse a Presentation on Screen
cards.subtitle: Hekman Library · basement level
cards.notes: Use a small table with a TV for group-project work or a presentation run-through, leaving shared equipment ready for others.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level library lobby with tables and screens that support collaborative presentation work.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin describes Hekman Library's basement lobby as an expansive study area with small tables and TVs for group projects or presentation practice.
cards.source_title: 12 Study Spaces Students Love at Calvin University
cards.access_notes: Located inside Hekman Library; consult current library hours before visiting and follow any posted rules for shared screens.

cards.title: Build a Small-Group Work Session
cards.subtitle: Commons Union · Hekman Library
cards.notes: Use the tables and chairs for a small-group meeting, and choose this area when conversation suits the assignment.
cards.short_summary: A renovated Commons Union work area configured for small teams and collaborative meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin documents Commons Union study spaces and shows tables and chairs arranged for small-group work and team meetings.
cards.access_notes: Commons Union has separate unlocked and student/staff card-access periods; verify the current term schedule before visiting.
